transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have our routine pre-publication check-in for the catalog draft. I'd like to hear from submissions and technical screening staff regarding any status or master-file issues with our accepted films, particularly 'Glass Harbor,' which is currently listed at 94 minutes with its premiere status still marked for confirmation. Please go ahead and report anything you've found.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding Mara's catalog review has not refreshed, so that information isn't showing up in the current catalog draft.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94 minutes listed in the catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and has not yet been attached to the programming record.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update 'Glass Harbor' runtime from 94 minutes to 88 minutes and update premiere status to 'not a national premiere' based on confirmed prior public screening at Coastline Film Week.
Assign 'Glass Harbor' to the panorama program, as it is not eligible for national competition due to prior public screening in this country.
Use the approved 88-minute festival cut DCP as the screening master for 'Glass Harbor' in the panorama program.
Attach the QC report and national premiere database findings to the programming record for 'Glass Harbor' before catalog publication.
